Volkswagen Caddy Maxi Life or similar

cargoZones.label: Boot behind third row with all 7 seats in use
cargoZones.notes: Published 7-seat boot volume and rear cargo width are sourced; rectangular dimensions combine the sourced floor length/width with an estimated cuboid height for MVP packing. Soft bags fit more reliably than rigid boxes because the third-row seatbacks and tailgate trim reduce usable shape.

cargoZones.label: Cargo area with third row removed / folded, 5 seats available
cargoZones.notes: Five-seat luggage volume is sourced from rental/editorial references and cargo floor length behind row 2 is sourced from Volkswagen. Dimensions are an estimated rectangular planning envelope and do not guarantee clearance around folded/removed seat mounts.

cargoZones.label: Maximum cargo area with 2nd and 3rd rows removed
cargoZones.notes: Maximum load/luggage volume and floor length behind row 1 are sourced from Volkswagen. Dimensions estimate a box-like load floor and ignore seat rails, wheel arches, trim taper, and roof curvature.

seatConfigurations.label: All 7 seats in use
seatConfigurations.notes: Use this for normal airport-rental 7-passenger use; rental fleets often describe capacity as about four large bags with all passengers seated.

seatConfigurations.label: Third row removed / folded
seatConfigurations.notes: Assumes both third-row seats are unavailable for passengers and the remaining cargo area is used behind the second row.

seatConfigurations.label: 2nd and 3rd rows removed
seatConfigurations.notes: For two occupants plus maximum cargo; practical availability depends on whether rental seats can be removed or must stay in the vehicle.
